title: Fix a Shape
description: Draw a rectangle, then fix it instead of redrawing it: select it, nudge it, edit its points, and undo cleanly.

bubble.title: Mistakes are fixable
bubble.body: Every deposit can be moved, restyled, point-edited or undone. Nothing you draw is permanent until you export it.

bubble.title: Watch: point editing
bubble.body: Press Watch demo: the program draws a rectangle, opens Point edit mode, picks the top-left corner point, and nudges it with an arrow key.

demo.title: Point edit mode
demo.body: Opening Point edit mode (Object ▸ Point Edit). The shape's anchor points appear.

demo.title: Picking the corner point
demo.body: Selecting the point at the cursor.

demo.title: Nudging the point
demo.body: Arrow keys move the selected point — the shape bends, it does not move.

demo.title: Done
demo.body: One corner pulled out of line — fixed shapes rarely need redrawing.

bubble.title: Draw anything
bubble.body: Steer to a corner and press I to start a rectangle. Any wobble is fine — you are about to fix it.

bubble.title: Deposited
bubble.body: Steer to the opposite corner and press I again to deposit the rectangle.

bubble.title: Deselect it
bubble.body: The new rectangle starts out selected. Press Escape — the selection clears, so the next step is a real selection.

bubble.title: Select it
bubble.body: Click the rectangle (mouse buttons still select and drag — keys are for drawing). Selecting is what tells the panel and the operations which object you mean.

bubble.title: Nudge it straight
bubble.body: With the rectangle selected, press an arrow key to nudge it. Shift makes the step bigger, Alt/Opt smaller. Steer, snap and nudge are how placement gets exact.

bubble.title: Open point editing
bubble.body: Choose Object ▸ Point Edit ▸ Point edit mode. The rectangle's anchor points appear — the shape is now editable point by point.

bubble.title: Move one point
bubble.body: Click a corner point to select it, then press an arrow key. The point moves and the shape bends — the rest of the rectangle stays put. Choose Point edit mode again when you are done.

bubble.title: Undo, and the point keys
bubble.body: Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes one action at a time, point moves included. The Keys Reference under Help lists every point-edit key — add, delete, smooth, corner. Redrawing is the last resort, not the first.
